entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter61/webappphases.rs::load creates Some(apply(base, d)) when no app exists; .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::install_app inserts declared
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter61/webappphases.rs::uninstall deletes only when owner == m; .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::uninstall removes the declared name
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::merged keeps undeclared keys of an existing app (lemma_adoption_keeps_undeclared general)
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::uninstall removes the adopted app by its declared name
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter61/webappphases.rs::load/apply rewrite declared properties; .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::merged keeps undeclared edits
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter61/webappphases.rs::load refuses when another module owns the name (owner state)
entries.note: iter5 refused_at_import is the identity on its input and carries no weight

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter61/webappphases.rs::apply keeps the old value for an attribute no longer declared
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter61/webappphases.rs::compile_only is the identity
entries.gap: compile_only(s) = s writes the outcome down; neither -only phase selection nor the processor phase filter (OnBeforePhase acts on Activate/Configure and Clean/Unconfigure) is modelled, so a compile that touched the app has no counterpart

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::upgrade_drops_declaration is the identity on apps; uninstall takes declared_name None as input
entries.gap: the upgrade step is written as the identity, so how update/install treats a resource dropped from the new manifest is not modelled; that the installed version no longer declares the app is the input None; only the uninstall half (deletes only declared names) is computed

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::validate_dispatches is the constant false
entries.gap: the as-built pass-through rests on the constant validate_dispatches() = false; the lifecycle %Validate dispatch (Lifecycle/Base.cls) that skips the processor OnPhase("Validate") check is not modelled

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter7/inputs.rs::differs: some declared key differs from the old value, absent old read as 0 (empty)
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter7/inputs.rs::app_status = modify_ok when differs, else true (Modify result is the stated condition)
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::failed_after_activate returns before when transaction, after otherwise
entries.gap: rollback is a two-row outcome table on the transaction flag; the %SYS Security.Applications write inside the load transaction and TROLLBACK are not modelled, so the removal is written down, not derived

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter5/webapp.rs::failed_after_activate without transaction keeps after_activate and module_recorded true
entries.gap: same outcome table: with -DNoTransaction=1 the kept application and module record are table entries, not derived from the absence of a transaction around the writes

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter8/webapps.rs::package_app = webapp_export_handled() || has_source_document; webapp_export_handled is the constant true
entries.gap: preservation of the declaration in the package rests on the constant webapp_export_handled() = true; the export of WebApplication declarations into the packaged module.xml is not modelled (the archive carries the declared PathExpr verbatim)

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter8/webapps.rs::evaluate_path evaluates a Csp path against the installation CSP root; reinstall inserts the evaluated path
entries.note: that the archive carries the {$cspdir} expression rests on package#2 (constant export)

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter7/inputs.rs::csp_directory/csp_path give root + resource when neither Directory nor DispatchClass
entries.note: normalization of the root is a premise

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter7/inputs.rs::csp_directory sets the -1 sentinel for DispatchClass alone; csp_after_before clears it
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter7/inputs.rs::csp_directory explicit Directory first
.g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter57/cspapp.rs::load sets app Some(...); uninstall sets app None
entries.gap: creating an application when none exists is never exercised: G7-m76 (load only updates an existing app) survives; only update of an existing app (takeover_resets_undeclared) and deletion are asserted

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter57/cspapp.rs::load copies source_files into deploy_files when has_deploy
entries.gap: the no-DeployPath case is never exercised: G7-m77 (copy even without DeployPath) survives; only the recopy with DeployPath is asserted

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter57/cspapp.rs::load writes admin_desc/admin_timeout as the constant false
entries.gap: the reset of undeclared properties is written as constants; the processor building the full ATTRIBUTES property array with defaults for undeclared properties (CreateOrUpdateCSPApp) is not modelled

entries.deciding: .g5/Verus_verification/consolidated/iter57/cspapp.rs::uninstall purges the deploy files with DeployPath, else the source files (Directory = DeployPath or source folder)
